hook: Most people learn to read a room. I had to *reverse-engineer* one.
intro: Social cues never came easily — people would say one thing and mean the opposite, and I needed to know *why*. So I started watching. Collecting patterns. Working out what people actually meant, so I'd know how to meet them.

That itch became a stack of psychology books. Then neuroscience — emotion is the layer sitting under every decision. Then anthropology, sociology, anything that explained how people work. It's also why I obsess over how a product *feels*, not just whether it works.
livesIntro: I've lived a few lives to get here —
comics: As a kid I drew and wrote my own comics. I was always going to make things — product design just finally gave the creativity somewhere to point.
missionIntro: And it pointed somewhere specific. The deeper I went, the clearer it got: technology quietly leaves people behind. Not fast enough, not abled enough, not enough access — and the future moves on without you.
peak: I build so *fewer people* get left.
dara: Right now that's Dara — an AI finance assistant for Nigerian freelancers and small businesses.
midShow: Off the clock, I'm mid-show. I watch for the people, never the plot.

films.title: Interview with the Vampire
films.why: Immortality as a relationship microscope — messy people problems that never die.

films.title: Shrinking
films.why: Grief and therapy played for warmth, not pity.

films.title: The Midnight Gospel
films.why: Psychedelic talks about death, the mind, and meaning.

films.title: Dark
films.why: Cause and effect across generations — the patterns that refuse to stay buried.

consoleHeading: I'm also mourning the console I don't own.
consoleBody: Console, PC, mobile — I'll play all of it. Raised on these. The PS5 wishlist stays open indefinitely.
friendCat: The rest of the time I'm getting dragged outside by a friend who's better at rest than I am. My *cat* supervises all of it.
health: I care, maybe too much, about how people are actually doing — mental health, and the physical stuff the system gets to last. Especially *women's health and autoimmune*. Same reflex that makes me build for the overlooked.
signoff: If you've read this far — hi. Let's build something for the people usually *skipped*. :)
